page.layout: One diagram block, with a running head at top right and the catchword at bottom right. The page number 341 sits at top right, and the signature "z 3" appears at the foot of the page.

main_text.l: Amplificatione, quæ est potissimum perorationis, habetœ

page.notes: The page is a printed synopsis with braces. The levels are read from the depth of the braces. The labels "quæ sunt vel" and "quæ fit aut" stand beside braces. The line "Tractatio deliberationis considerātur" is joined from the printed broken words "Tracta tio deli beratio nis con fidera- tur". The "Sedationes" box is read as "Sedationē". The original spelling "uerbis", "Vtilium" and "Vltionem" is given with v as the consonant. Some brace-label spellings are uncertain.
